'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
